display.name: Caddy
display.description: Caddy web server and reverse proxy metrics: request rate, status codes, latency, errors, bandwidth, upstream health, and config reloads. Built on the metrics that Caddy pushes over OTLP with the `metrics { otlp }` option.

display.name: Route
display.description: First handler of the route that sees every request. Keep tracing if you followed the setup guide. Every request panel uses it, except Requests per Second by Handler.

display.name: Service
display.description: Caddy service, from OTEL_SERVICE_NAME

display.name: Request Rate
display.description: Requests per second handled by Caddy, averaged over the selected range.

display.name: 5xx Responses (%)
display.description: Share of responses with a 5xx status code over the selected range.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND handler = $route AND code LIKE '5%'

display.name: Requests In Flight
display.description: Requests that Caddy is handling right now, summed across servers.

display.name: Unhealthy Upstreams
display.description: Reverse proxy upstreams that report unhealthy right now. Needs active or passive health checks in reverse_proxy.

display.name: Requests per Second by Handler
display.description: Request rate of every route, by server and the first handler of the route. A request counts once for each route it matches, so do not add the lines up.

display.name: Requests per Second by Status Code
display.description: Request rate by HTTP response status code.

display.name: Requests per Second by Method
display.description: Request rate by HTTP method.

display.name: Requests In Flight by Server
display.description: Requests that each Caddy server is handling at the same time.

display.name: Request Duration (p50, p95, p99)
display.description: Round-trip request duration percentiles across all servers.

display.name: p95 Request Duration by Server
display.description: 95th percentile round-trip request duration for each Caddy server.

display.name: p95 Request Duration by Status Code
display.description: 95th percentile request duration for each response status code.

display.name: p95 Time to First Byte by Server
display.description: 95th percentile time until Caddy writes the first byte of the response body.

display.name: 4xx and 5xx Responses per Second
display.description: Rate of responses with a 4xx or 5xx status code, by code.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND handler = $route AND (code LIKE '4%' OR code LIKE '5%')

display.name: Middleware Errors per Second by Server
display.description: Rate of requests that ended in a handler error, such as an upstream that does not respond.

display.name: Request Bandwidth by Server
display.description: Bytes per second that clients send to each Caddy server, headers and body included.

display.name: Response Bandwidth by Server
display.description: Bytes per second that each Caddy server sends in response bodies.

display.name: p95 Request Size by Server
display.description: 95th percentile request size for each Caddy server.

display.name: p95 Response Size by Server
display.description: 95th percentile response body size for each Caddy server.

display.name: Upstream Health
display.description: Health of each reverse proxy upstream: 1 is healthy, 0 is unhealthy. Needs active or passive health checks in reverse_proxy. Shows the lowest value across Caddy instances.

display.name: Last Config Reload Successful
display.description: 1 when the last configuration reload succeeded, 0 when it failed. Shows the lowest value across Caddy instances.
